gotchas: frontierairlines.com redirects to flyfrontier.com; booking runs on booking.flyfrontier.com. Guest checkout, no login needed.

Flow: Select flight -> Discount Den vs Standard price (pick Standard 'Continue') -> 'Upgrade to Economy' modal (tick the 'Basic Fare works for me' checkbox, then 'Continue with Basic' #ContinueBasic) -> GoWild Pass upsell drawer ('No thanks, continue with standard') -> Passenger Info -> Bundle (Continue, then 'Continue without a bundle' modal) -> Seats (Continue, then 'Continue without selecting seats') -> Bags (No Carry-On, No Checked Bags, Continue, then 'Continue without adding a Carry-On') -> Extras -> Payment.

The page is very heavy (380+ inputs, many hidden dialogs): clicks that navigate can take 30-60s to return and snapshots/screenshots can time out with ariaSnapshot 10s; give clicks a 60s timeout and retry the snapshot after a pause.

Passenger Info fields: #frontierPassengers_0__Name_First, #frontierPassengers_0__Name_Last, #frontierPassengers_0__Info_Gender (select), #date_of_birth_0 (type MM/DD/YYYY), contact #frontierContact_Name_First/_Last, #frontierContact_EmailAddress, #js_first_phone_number (digits only), #frontierContact_CountryCode, #frontierContact_PostalCode; submit #submit_passenger_info_button.

Extras step is blocking: Disruption Assistance and Cancel For Any Reason are radios inside two third-party iframes and an opt-out ('No thanks') must be chosen in each, plus Self-Service (#ibe-extras-agent-assist-radio-free), or Continue shows errors.

Payment: card fields are inline (no iframe). Expiry is two selects (#card_expiration_month, #card_expiration_year). Billing 'Same as contact information' is checked by default but the address/city/state/email inputs still render and are required. Address 1 has maxlength 30.

Order total for the spending guard: #payment_cart_total_amount (resolves, e.g. $92.98 USD). The final button is 'PURCHASE & ACCEPT' (a.js-paymentSubmitButton), disabled until the terms checkbox is ticked - never click it.
